title: M/s Disha Industries Limited v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Krishna Murari, J. and Ashwani Kumar Mishra, J. (11.7.2014); Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Prashant Kumar, J. (6.4.2023)
disposition: Dismissed as infructuous; additional-security demand not decided.
headnote: Writ against a demand notice for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. In 2014 the Court, without prejudice and following interim protection in a connected similar matter, restrained the respondents from demanding additional security. In 2023 the petition was dismissed as infructuous on the petitioner's statement, without deciding the demand.
facts: M/s Disha Industries Limited challenged a demand notice dated 2 April 2014 issued by the distribution licensee for additional security under paragraph 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The High Court, noting that a similar writ (M/s Supreme Ceramics Limited) had been entertained with interim protection, restrained the respondents from demanding additional security until further orders and directed listing with connected matters. On 6 April 2023 counsel stated that the petition had become infructuous, and it was dismissed accordingly.

holding_units.holding: A writ challenging a demand notice for additional security under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was first met with a without-prejudice interim restraint on the demand, aligned with a connected similar writ; the petition was later dismissed as infructuous on the petitioner's statement, without any determination of the demand.

not_decided.point: Whether the additional-security demand under clause 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was lawful
not_decided.note: Petition dismissed as infructuous without a merits decision.
